  • Source: ck18y530/GPSUSER

Source header

Name
CLEANUP
Purpose
Clean up campaign of LEOPOD processing: - Append first 100 lines of GNSS PRE file and clock RINEX file, as well as ERP file to PRC file - Delete GNSS clock RINEX file - Delete LEO RINEX file and smoothed LEO RINEX file - Delete LEO attitude file - Delete OUT/$A$YSS+0.CLK (CODSPP of PID 110) - Delete OUT/M$A?$YSS+0.RES (MAUPRP of PID 140) - Delete OUT/$A$YSS+0.RES (GPSEST of PID 150) - Compress OUT/KN$F$YSS+0.COV (GPSEST of PID 600) - Compress OUT/KN$F$YSS+0.CLK (GPSEST of PID 600) The Bernese clock file and the GNSS orbit and ERP files are not deleted since they might still be used if several LEOs are processed in parallel.
Author
D. Arnold
Created
20-Dec-2016
Changes
11-Dec-2017 DA: Delete also SMT file 13-Apr-2022 DA: Removed DIR_TAB and EXT_TAB 15-Nov-2024 DA: Check if PRC avail., use V_ATT, del. BSW clk. file 18-Nov-2024 DA: Do not del. BSW clk. file (parallel POD)

Source header

Name
FIX_CHK
Purpose
Execute HELMR1 Remark : This script permits automatic verification of a given set of fiducial stations. In case of discrepancies, a modified FIX file can be output by HELMR1 and thus used to directly repeat the last ADDNEQ2 run, finally considering a reduced set of fiducial stations accepted for consistent datum definition.
Parameters
PARAM2 - goto PID for new datum definition (optionally) PARAM3 - STOP option for CRD (cross-)checking (optionally)
Author
M. Meindl, S. Schaer
Created
19-Oct-2003
Changes
07-Feb-2006/ss: Check whether PARAM2 defined 02-Sep-2010/ss/mm: Deactivated outlier rejection for second HELMR1 run 26-Sep-2012/ss: Further developed 27-Sep-2012/ss: STOP option implemented (activated with PARAM3) 28-Sep-2012/ss: Print LST filename in case of a stop 17-Apr-2013/hb: Exception for doy 13102 F1-F1C added 18-Apr-2013/cb: Exception for doy 13103 F3-F3C added 29-May-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13144 F3S and 13145 F1S added 30-May-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13146 F1S and 13145 F3S added 31-May-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13147 F1S and 13146 F3S added 01-Jun-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13148 F1S and 13147 F3S added 02-Jun-2013/cb: Exceptions for doy 13149 F1S and 13148 F3S added 03-Jun-2013/hb: Exceptions for doy 13150 F1S and 13149 F3S added 03-Jun-2013/ss: Most recent exceptions removed 04-Jun-2014/ss: Considered ULTyyddd.FLG 10-Sep-2014/ss: Increased tolerances in case of RAP 16-Dec-2014/ss/av: Updated for new HELMR1 (with ADDSTA/MAXREJ) 16-SEP-2015/rd: Relax HELMR1 check if singular elements are detected 18-May-2021/ec: Adapt script to FZDMGNSS (add $sol variable)

Source header

Name
PPP_RES_SUM
Purpose
Check zero- or double-difference data screening results and creates a summary on the residual screening: 1. RESRMS to create F(irst) residual screening summary 2. RESRMS to create L(ast) residual screening summary 3. RESCHK to create residual screening statistics Binary data files of misbehaving stations are subsequently removed if indicated After deleting stations the BPE processing is continued with SNGDIF in case of double-difference processing.
Parameters
PARAM1 - "NEXTJOB"-indicator (if necessary) PARAM2 - goto PID in case of misbehaving stations
